id.description: id for the input. Label/hint/error ids are derived from this.

name.description: name attribute for the input. Defaults to id.

hint.description: Hint text displayed below the label.

error.description: Error message. Renders aria-describedby and error styling.

defaultValue.description: Initial value for uncontrolled usage. Also used as the static value shown in the Django/HTML templates.

textUnit.description: Optional unit appended to the screen-reader value callout, e.g. "percent".

textPreposition.description: Preposition used in the screen-reader value callout ("of", "de", etc.).

formGroup.description: Whether to wrap the label/hint/error/control in a `.usa-form-group`. Set to `false` when composing inside another form group.

className.description: Additional classes for the usa-range input.

default.label: Range slider
default.hint: Move the slider to change the value
